q: A roundabout makes $15$ revolutions per minute. What is its rotation frequency in $\tfrac{1}{\text{s}}$ and its period?
Point A of a rotating disc is $3.0\,\text{cm}$ from the axis and point B $9.0\,\text{cm}$ from it. How many times as great is the tangential speed of B as that of A?
a:
Three times as great. The points have the same period, and the tangential speed $v = \tfrac{2\pi r}{T}$ is then directly proportional to the radius. The ratio of the distances is thus the ratio of the tangential speeds:

$\dfrac{9.0\,\text{cm}}{3.0\,\text{cm}} = 3.0$.
